prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / background compositing.
Edit this RUSHITADEL title image into ONE unified scene whose background NATURALLY INTERMINGLES FOUR BIOMES: grass, ice, water, lava. This is a single landscape, NOT a four-panel collage, NOT four quadrants, NOT split strips of different colors.
Preserve foreground interface EXACTLY: centered RUSHITADEL logo, mint pixel font, all four vertically stacked buttons and their sizes/positions/icons/borders/selection/color, exact text "게임 시작", "이어하기", "설정", "게임 종료". No added words, frames or HUD. Keep five-turret gray-purple player at bottom center on low central road. Preserve two red-core enemies per side standing atop the elevated cliffs. Same composition and scale.
Replace/rework background so grass, ice, water and volcanic stone organically overlap through terrain logic and irregular transitions rather than isolated theme corners. One continuous shared slate rock geology and consistent top-down camera/lighting. Frost-tipped rocky outcrops give way to melting blue ice, narrow meltwater streams weave around mossy grass patches and into small teal pools; damp rock and sparse green tufts reappear along water edges across BOTH banks. Charcoal basalt seams weave through that same rock with a few small glowing ember-orange lava fissures, whose cooled dark borders meet mossy stone. Sparse residual ice pockets appear near water even beyond main icy outcrops. Grass patches interleave with stone, water and melting frost. All four themes visibly belong to the SAME physical landscape, no straight theme borders, no color-wash segmentation. Do not put grass only upper-left, ice only upper-right, water only lower-left, lava only lower-right; use natural varied small overlapping shapes and shared neutral transitions. Keep liquid lava separate from water by cooled stone ledges, no chaotic mixing of liquid colors.
Preserve higher left and right cliff banks descending into a clear central lower dry rocky road. Environmental detail mostly in outer thirds, central road visually quiet behind UI. Moderate restrained decoration: a few readable pools/streams, small ice patches, sparse grass, restrained lava cracks. Not dense fantasy illustration, no giant crystals, forests, waterfalls, fog, particles or new structures. All scenery lower contrast and gently darkened/desaturated to sit behind sharp mint UI. Four biomes recognizable but harmonious navy/slate ambient palette, moderate luminosity not pitch black, orange lava not overpowering.
Crisp PIXEL ART everywhere including UI; square pixel clusters, limited matte shade ramps, no blur, no photorealism, no glossy 3D or smooth vector graphics. Single clean casual-classic game title scene.
